boards.name: Gippslander
boards.notes: Employer prices shown per job including GST: Standard $49 (30 days), Featured $89 (45 days). Partner plan $599 a year. Employer profile free. Checkout via Stripe. No API or feed mentioned on the pages read.

sources.title: Partner plan
sources.quote: $599 a year · Next: secure checkout with Stripe

boards.name: CuratorSearch
boards.notes: Single job listing costs 100 euros for 30 days, invoice available on request. Public API page says no key needed for the MCP server; the JSON API page does not state whether a key is required. Full feed requires a keyed partner feed requested by email. Homepage also shows a 5 euro per month offer whose audience is not stated.

sources.title: Developer docs, partner feed
sources.quote: email support@curatorsearch.com with the subject "Partner Feed."

boards.name: aitrainer.work
boards.notes: Single role listings from $49 or $99, one-time payment for 30 days, paid via Stripe. Also offers job listing syndication, referral placements, and advertising. Homepage lists a job feed for your site and an MCP server, with no access or key terms stated. Site is run by founder Pietro Romeo; no parent company named.

sources.title: Hiring partners
sources.quote: We list your open roles on the board and keep them current as you open and close them.

boards.name: TwinPro
boards.notes: Career agency for accounting and finance professionals. Footer names MyVision, Inc. as copyright holder and lists five group services. The relationship is not described as parent or subsidiary. Employer posting, pricing, API and partner terms not described on pages read.
